# WPS 100-199 Naming

Every violation in the Naming group of wemake-python-styleguide 1.8.1, from its [docs](https://wemake-python-styleguide.readthedocs.io/en/latest/pages/usage/violations/naming.html).
Disabled ones are struck through.

| Code | Violation | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| WPS100 | [WrongModuleNameViolation](https://wemake-python-styleguide.readthedocs.io/en/latest/pages/usage/violations/naming.html#wemake_python_styleguide.violations.naming.WrongModuleNameViolation) | Forbid blacklisted module names. |
| WPS101 | [WrongModuleMagicNameViolation](https://wemake-python-styleguide.readthedocs.io/en/latest/pages/usage/violations/naming.html#wemake_python_styleguide.violations.naming.WrongModuleMagicNameViolation) | Forbid magic names (except some whitelisted ones). |
| WPS102 | [WrongModuleNamePatternViolation](https://wemake-python-styleguide.readthedocs.io/en/latest/pages/usage/violations/naming.html#wemake_python_styleguide.violations.naming.WrongModuleNamePatternViolation) | Forbid module names that do not match our pattern. |
| WPS110 | [WrongVariableNameViolation](https://wemake-python-styleguide.readthedocs.io/en/latest/pages/usage/violations/naming.html#wemake_python_styleguide.violations.naming.WrongVariableNameViolation) | Forbid blacklisted variable names. |
| WPS111 | [TooShortNameViolation](https://wemake-python-styleguide.readthedocs.io/en/latest/pages/usage/violations/naming.html#wemake_python_styleguide.violations.naming.TooShortNameViolation) | Forbid short variable or module names. |
| WPS112 | [PrivateNameViolation](https://wemake-python-styleguide.readthedocs.io/en/latest/pages/usage/violations/naming.html#wemake_python_styleguide.violations.naming.PrivateNameViolation) | Forbid private name pattern. |
| WPS113 | ~~[SameAliasImportViolation](https://wemake-python-styleguide.readthedocs.io/en/latest/pages/usage/violations/naming.html#wemake_python_styleguide.violations.naming.SameAliasImportViolation)~~ disabled since 1.0.0 | Forbid using the same alias as the original name in imports. |
| WPS114 | [UnderscoredNumberNameViolation](https://wemake-python-styleguide.readthedocs.io/en/latest/pages/usage/violations/naming.html#wemake_python_styleguide.violations.naming.UnderscoredNumberNameViolation) | Forbid names with underscored numbers pattern. |
| WPS115 | [UpperCaseAttributeViolation](https://wemake-python-styleguide.readthedocs.io/en/latest/pages/usage/violations/naming.html#wemake_python_styleguide.violations.naming.UpperCaseAttributeViolation) | Require `snake_case` for naming class attributes. |
| WPS116 | [ConsecutiveUnderscoresInNameViolation](https://wemake-python-styleguide.readthedocs.io/en/latest/pages/usage/violations/naming.html#wemake_python_styleguide.violations.naming.ConsecutiveUnderscoresInNameViolation) | Forbid using more than one consecutive underscore in variable names. |
| WPS117 | [ReservedArgumentNameViolation](https://wemake-python-styleguide.readthedocs.io/en/latest/pages/usage/violations/naming.html#wemake_python_styleguide.violations.naming.ReservedArgumentNameViolation) | Forbid naming variables `self`, `cls`, or `mcs`. |
| WPS118 | [TooLongNameViolation](https://wemake-python-styleguide.readthedocs.io/en/latest/pages/usage/violations/naming.html#wemake_python_styleguide.violations.naming.TooLongNameViolation) | Forbid long variable or module names. |
| WPS119 | [UnicodeNameViolation](https://wemake-python-styleguide.readthedocs.io/en/latest/pages/usage/violations/naming.html#wemake_python_styleguide.violations.naming.UnicodeNameViolation) | Forbid unicode names. |
| WPS120 | [TrailingUnderscoreViolation](https://wemake-python-styleguide.readthedocs.io/en/latest/pages/usage/violations/naming.html#wemake_python_styleguide.violations.naming.TrailingUnderscoreViolation) | Forbid trailing `_` for names that do not need it. |
| WPS121 | [UnusedVariableIsUsedViolation](https://wemake-python-styleguide.readthedocs.io/en/latest/pages/usage/violations/naming.html#wemake_python_styleguide.violations.naming.UnusedVariableIsUsedViolation) | Forbid using variables that are marked as unused. |
| WPS122 | [UnusedVariableIsDefinedViolation](https://wemake-python-styleguide.readthedocs.io/en/latest/pages/usage/violations/naming.html#wemake_python_styleguide.violations.naming.UnusedVariableIsDefinedViolation) | Forbid explicit unused variables. |
| WPS123 | [WrongUnusedVariableNameViolation](https://wemake-python-styleguide.readthedocs.io/en/latest/pages/usage/violations/naming.html#wemake_python_styleguide.violations.naming.WrongUnusedVariableNameViolation) | Forbid unused variables with multiple underscores. |
| WPS124 | [UnreadableNameViolation](https://wemake-python-styleguide.readthedocs.io/en/latest/pages/usage/violations/naming.html#wemake_python_styleguide.violations.naming.UnreadableNameViolation) | Forbid variable or module names which could be difficult to read. |
| WPS125 | ~~[BuiltinShadowingViolation](https://wemake-python-styleguide.readthedocs.io/en/latest/pages/usage/violations/naming.html#wemake_python_styleguide.violations.naming.BuiltinShadowingViolation)~~ disabled since 1.0.0 | Forbid variable or module names which shadow builtin names. |
